_metadata.description: District-owned properties in the Redwood City School District that are not currently RCSD-operated schools. Includes administrative buildings, leased-out former school sites, and operational facilities. District school sites are tracked in schools.json; charter schools in charters.json. A former-school campus that hosts a charter appears here too when the district also leases parts of it to other tenants (e.g. the Hawes campus).

sources.districtInventory: TBD — seed data from Board President (2026-04-17); authoritative list pending
